Profile Summary
Senior Business Analyst with 14+ years of experience in Global Banking and Financial Services, including 8+ years in Business Analysis across Corporate Actions, Reconciliation, Transaction Lifecycle Management, and Client Servicing. Lead end-to-end business analysis for the TLM platform, supporting reconciliation of cash and securities across internal systems and external counterparties. strategic transformation initiatives.
